decline.permutation_note: 20000 draws of 31 trades from all 346, seed 20261009; share at or below the live mean. The live window was chosen after it looked bad, so this p is optimistic.

price_30m_stitch.rule: the recent export replaces the history export from its first bar onward

context_coverage.note: the price exports end 2026-10-03; a trade entered after the next bar would have closed has no context and is left out of the K-bar, BB, DXY, MTF and decline-context tables, never given the last available bar

method.bar_alignment: every price bar is stamped at its close before joining (30m +30min, 60m +60min, 4H +4h, 1D +1 day), so each context value is read from the last COMPLETED bar before entry; see RS-XAUUSD-20260901-001 for why the toolkit's bar-open join is not used
method.price_30m: FX_IDC XAUUSD 30m, two TradingView exports stitched (see price_30m_stitch)
method.price_60m: resampled from the stitched 30m series (left-labelled hourly bins, then close-stamped)
method.rsi_provenance: locally_computed_wilder_rsi14 (+ SMA14 RSI-MA) on every series; no export carried native RSI for the full range
method.bb_params: period=20, std_mult=2.0, population std (ddof=0) as in fail_pattern_toolkit.compute_bb, on 30m close
method.dxy_params: TVC DXY 1D, RSI(14) bucket, 20-day SMA trend, RSI-vs-MA momentum; joined on close-stamped time
method.mtf_params: 60m/4H/1D RSI(14) state and bucket; HTF alignment = count of bullish timeframes
method.temporal_stability_limitation: This is a chronological-bucket / holdout-split check on ONE static TradingView strategy-tester export, not a re-optimized walk-forward: the underlying Pine Script strategy logic is never re-run or re-tuned on any sub-window here. It can show whether the recorded win rate / profit factor is stable or concentrated in an earlier stretch of the export; it cannot prove the strategy's parameters would have been chosen the same way if only the early data had ever existed.
method.temporal_stability_buckets: calendar quarter (YYYY-Qn) of entry_time; 2026-Q4 is partial (to 2026-10-09)
method.temporal_stability_holdout: chronological split, first 70% entry-time-ordered trades = in_sample, last 30% = held_out
method.temporal_stability_degradation_rule: degraded: held_out.win_rate_pct < in_sample.win_rate_ci95_pct[0] OR held_out.profit_factor < 1.0; improved: held_out.win_rate_pct > in_sample.win_rate_ci95_pct[1] AND held_out.profit_factor > in_sample.profit_factor; else stable
method.decline_windows: reference = entries before 2026-08-16; live = entries on or after it (31 trades, the Telegram push regime)
method.gold_trend_20d: gold close of the last closed daily bar vs 20 daily bars earlier; falling < -2.0%, rising > +2.0%, else flat
method.atr_pct_30m: Wilder ATR(14) of the last closed 30m bar / its close x 100; terciles cut on reference trades only; a trade with no 30m bar within 1 hour before entry is 'unknown'
method.window_gold_drift: gold daily close at or before the first entry vs at or before the last exit of the window
method.shift_share: delta mean return = sum w_live*(m_live-m_ref) [within] + sum (w_live-w_ref)*m_ref [mix]
method.return_unit: Return % of the Strategy Tester (position value ~10k USD, stop distance ~0.5%), so -0.50 is about -1R
